subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness + hosting constraints for MedicoHealth
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@medicohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: Procurement readiness + hosting constraints for MedicoHealth

Thanks again for carving out time this morning, Rachel — good conversation. Below is a short recap and concrete next steps so we can align with procurement and your infra/security teams. Please correct anything I missed.

Summary of pain/goals
- Data residency: all PHI will remain within EU (Germany preferred). No cross-border egress to US.
- Network/topology: MedicoHealth requires either VPC peering or PrivateLink-style connectivity; no public internet egress for inference traffic.
- Air-gap/maintenance: customer-managed maintenance windows and a path for air-gapped patching for regulated releases.
- Key management: HSM-backed keys preferred (KMS integration acceptable if HSM-backed on your side).
- Compliance: SOC 2 + ISO27001 evidence requested; questionnaire attached.

Technical constraints we discussed
- Minimum egress band: 300 Mbps sustained for peak windows; ephemeral outbound only to Redwood control plane for metrics (need to confirm allowed endpoints).
- No shared persistent storage outside your VPC; model artifacts must be scoped to your tenancy.

Next steps (owner / ETA)
1) Redwood to share on-prem pricing + hosting options and a network requirements template (attachment: redwood_onprem_pricing.xlsx, network_requirements_template.pdf) — Logan — EOD 10/04
2) MedicoHealth to return filled security questionnaire and call out any hard blockers (attachment: security_questionnaire_v2.pdf) — Rachel / Procurement — by 10/10
3) Draft mutual action plan / SOW for dedicated VPC deployment (Laura) — draft by 10/09
4) Procurement kickoff meeting to lock PO timeline and procurement contacts — propose 10/05 09:00 CET (calendar link below)

If that aligns, I’ll drop the M.A.P. and a first-draft SOW into the HubSpot deal and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onprem_pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_requirements_template.pdf (pdf)

From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@medicohealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medicohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 10:01:21 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness + hosting constraints for MedicoHealth

Logan — thanks for the clear recap. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Residency: Germany is required — we can accept EU-only but would prefer physical residency in DE for auditability.
- KMS/HSM: We run an on-prem HSM (Luna) and need Redwood to support BYOK where our HSM signs keys; if not possible, we need to know the security tradeoffs.
- Air-gap: We do not want outbound connections from the inferencing fleet to public endpoints. Can Redwood support a reverse-proxy model where only the control plane has limited egress and inference work is fully private?

I attached our updated security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_v2.pdf) — procurement will go through it and get back to you.

Timeline note: procurement is targeting a purchase decision by end of Q4 (12/22), but legal wants an initial SOW in the next two weeks.

Thanks,
Rachel
Head of IT Security
MedicoHealth

Attachments: security_questionnaire_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@medicohealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 11:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness + hosting constraints for MedicoHealth

Rachel — great to meet you over the call. I’m putting together a concise mutual action plan and a procurement checklist to make legal/procurement reviews faster. Quick notes from me on the procurement path and what we’ll include in the SOW:
- SOW will enumerate: deployment model (VPC-dedicated on-prem), ingress/egress policy, maintenance windows, incident escalation SLAs, and data residency appendix (Germany).
- Security evidence we will provide: SOC 2 Type II report, encryption-at-rest / in-transit details, and an architecture diagram for on-prem installs.
- HSM/BYOK: we can support BYOK flows; engineering will confirm any agent/connector required for your Luna HSM.
- Air-gap options: we offer a private control plane or a customer-hosted control plane with out-of-band telemetry ingestion — we’ll include both options in the SOW.

Requested from MedicoHealth for the SOW:
- Filled network_requirements_template.pdf with CIDR ranges and allowed egress endpoints
- Confirmation of maintenance windows (local CET times)
- Legal contact and procurement contact for DocuSign routing

I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_medico.pdf) — it’s a working draft. I’ll iterate once we get the completed questionnaire and your procurement inputs.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Enterprise Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_medico.pdf (pdf)

From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@medicohealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 13:22:12 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement readiness + hosting constraints for MedicoHealth

Laura — received the draft MAP and it looks good. Procurement confirms:
- We will return the filled network template and the security questionnaire by 10/10.
- Legal will expect an SOW draft by 10/09 for review.
- PO target: week of 12/18; earliest deployment window: Jan 2029.

We also request a short technical readout for our infra team (30m) to confirm the HSM connector and the private-control-plane option before SOW finalization — can Redwood hold a slot 10/12 or 10/13?

Thanks,
Rachel

Attachments: (none)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Perfect — appreciate the timelines. We’ll: 
- Drop the revised SOW + MAP into HubSpot by 10/09.
- Hold a 30-minute technical readout on 10/12 at 10:00 CET (calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=medico-kickoff-20281012) — invite sent.

Ben and I will loop in our engineering lead for the HSM connector discussion; Laura will handle procurement artifacts. If anything changes on your end, flag it in this thread so we don’t duplicate work.

Catch you on the readout — Logan

--
